title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 10

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the integrated handover meeting take place?
tasks.audioText: The project coordinator will hold an integrated handover meeting on Friday at one. Representatives from mechanical, electrical and quality teams should bring their latest status summaries. The meeting will identify interface issues, outstanding evidence and actions that depend on more than one team. Each action should have an owner and a target review date.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which teams should bring status summaries?
tasks.audioText: The project coordinator will hold an integrated handover meeting on Friday at one. Representatives from mechanical, electrical and quality teams should bring their latest status summaries. The meeting will identify interface issues, outstanding evidence and actions that depend on more than one team. Each action should have an owner and a target review date.

tasks.prompt: A manufacturing project involved mechanical assembly, electrical integration and quality inspection. The mechanical team had completed the housing, while the electrical team was waiting for a connector specification to be confirmed. Quality staff had prepared an inspection plan but needed the final assembly revision. The coordinator recorded these dependencies so that each team could see which action depended on information from another group. Reading 1. What was the electrical team waiting for?
Why did the coordinator record the dependencies?
options: So each team could see which action depended on information from another group

tasks.prompt: Each outstanding action ___ to an owner and a review date.
Choose TWO features of an effective cross-disciplinary handover.
A task or result that depends on another task is a ___.
An action depends on a document from another team. What should you say?
options: This action depends on the confirmed connector specification; could the responsible team provide its status and target date?
The other team is always responsible.
I will close the action without evidence.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of cross-disciplinary handover in a logical order.
options: Review outstanding actions at the next handover
correctOrder: Review outstanding actions at the next handover

tasks.prompt: Write 100–120 words summarising a cross-disciplinary handover. Explain one dependency between teams and how it should be tracked.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); precise technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
